set.body: Documentation CI on e8c2c0b and 5556d1f rejects a training assessment because ref_assess checks training identity once for its safety gate and scores_from_dists hashes it again later. Fresh R 4.5.1, fresh R 4.6.1, and six-file Quarto R 4.6.1 repros pass, so preserve the entry provenance decision throughout a single assessment and add a forced drift regression test.
set.title: Stabilize assessment provenance within one scoring call
